body:
## **If you’re still using your Eden/Connex legacy family printer, then why not upgrade to our market leading J55™ Prime full color office environment machine and start enjoying these benefits:**

**1\. Expand your applications**

The J55 Prime jets 5 modeling materials simultaneously for a WIDER RANGE OF APPLICATIONS enabling FULL COLOR combinations with over 600K available colors and Pantone Validated™ pallets in both matte and glossy finishes. Furthermore, when printing with a 5-material configuration NO RESIN REPLACEMENT is needed, saving you not only time, but wasted material.

![](/assets/uploads/blog/7-reasons-to-upgrade-to-j55-prime-1.webp)

**2\. End to end solution**

Enjoy a complete end-to-end service that will take you from concept to full-color tactile or engineering detailed design. Use the VeroVivid Cyan, Magenta, and Yellow materials, as well as the VeroUltra™WhiteS and VeroUltra™BlackS, to create full-color CMF (colour material finish) models. VeroUltra™ClearS is a PMMA-like material that looks, feels, and functions like glass. Combine the Elastico™ Black or Elastico™ Clear for a rubber-like texture at SHORE A 45 to expand your CMF DESIGN CAPABILITIES. For engineering use cases and combinations of VeroUltra™ and Elastico™ to obtain varied Shore scale A values, use Digital ABS Plus Ivory. Enjoy the advantages of VeroContact™ Clear, our BIOCOMPATIBLE MATERIAL.

![](/assets/uploads/blog/7-reasons-to-upgrade-to-j55-prime-2.webp)

![](/assets/uploads/blog/7-reasons-to-upgrade-to-j55-prime-3.webp)

**3\. Ease to use**

USER MAINTAINABILITY TIME HAS BEEN REDUCED BY 50% DUE TO NEW DESIGN FEATURES FOR EASY USE. With the J55 Prime, you can now go straight from CAD to Print with a super-streamlined workflow for excellent RELIABILITY AND MAINTAINABILITY; the requirement for assistance has been cut in half! Use the ground-breaking innovative WATER-SOLUBLE SUPPORT MATERIAL WSS™150, which dissolves in common tap water without the use of any chemicals. It's especially useful in situations when hand support removal could cause parts to shatter, and it allows for a labor-free one-step process for huge numbers of small parts.

**4.** **Complete fit for office environment**

The J55 Prime printer is a complete fit for your office environment: ODOR FREE AND VERY QUIET (less than 53db) with a SMALLER FOOTPRINT. The J55 Prime boasts an almost 30% build tray to printer footprint ratio compared to a much smaller 4-6% ratio on your Connex 260 legacy systems.

**5\. Improved productivity and throughput**

Upgrade today for improved productivity and enjoy parts with fine details and a SMOOTH SURFACE FINISH that can only be reached with PolyJet™ technology. In addition of an INCREASED BUILD SIZE of around twice the size of the current build size of your Connex 260 Legacy system.

![](/assets/uploads/blog/7-reasons-to-upgrade-to-j55-prime-4.webp)

**6\. Sustainability**

The J55 Prime is the right answer to the challenging times that supply chains face today. Upgrade now for immediate ON DEMAND AND IN-HOUSE printing, so no waste, NO SHIPPING, no stocks or storage expenses at all. What’s more our new water – soluble support material is compatible with the J55 Prime for simple, HANDSFREE SUPPORT REMOVAL with tap water only. NO ADDITIONAL CHEMICALS are needed, and it can be used together with our L2S™ powder for SAFE WASTEWATER DISPOSAL, according to local regulations.

**7\. Improved cost per part**

Draft Grey's SUPER LOW-COST PRINTING is around 50% less expensive for FAST ITERATIONS needed during the design stage, as well as REDUCED COSTS for support materials and FUNCTIONAL ADVANCED MATERIALS like Elastico™ and Digital ABS Plus. Because the J55 Prime has five channels, it requires fewer material changes, resulting in significant cost savings.

![](/assets/uploads/blog/7-reasons-to-upgrade-to-j55-prime-5.webp)
